title: dcerpc-netlogon: improve decryption of connection where ServerAuthenticate{,2,3}() happens within an encrypted connection
description:
The session key for the dcerpc transport protection with auth_type 68
is copied from the global state during the DCERPC Bind/AlterContext

commits_data.title: dcerpc-netlogon: remember the session key per auth_context_id
commits_data.message:
dcerpc-netlogon: remember the session key per auth_context_id

The netlogon session key is copied during the DCERPC Bind/AlterContext
(with auth_type 68) from the global state.

The DCERPC transport encryption is based on the copied session key
and it's possible to have ServerAuthenticate{,2,3} requests
within the encryption connection to reset the global session key.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
